content:
alex: heads up — found a weird repro where request IDs disappear from logs after an auth retry when otel hooks are enabled. minimal repro attached below

alex: steps: 1) node-sdk with auto-otel hook enabled 2) make call that gets 401 -> SDK refreshes token and retries 3) original attempt logs have reqId, retry logs have no reqId

alex: log snippet:```INFO 2026-02-15 service=req handler=start reqId=abc123
INFO 2026-02-15 auth=refresh token=ok
INFO 2026-02-15 service=req handler=retry reqId= - // blank here
```

maria: thanks — can you paste your SDK version and whether you use express middleware or manual tracing?

alex: sdk@0.24.1, using express with our middleware that calls Redwood.init() early. otel auto-instrumentation via @opentelemetry/instrumentation-http

jong: sounds like hook ordering/race — we saw a similar pattern but usually with async-hooks race on startup. @maria any quick guesses?

maria: likely the telemetry hook that injects the reqId header runs before the retry wrapper re-attaches context on the second attempt. need to ensure the retry preserves the same span/context or re-injects headers.

sam: can confirm repro locally. also noticed that if I set REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY=0 the reqId stays. so it's definitely tied to retry path.

telemetry-bot: automated-check: open-telemetry hook order mismatch heuristic triggered for repo=web-app, branch=fix/retry-reqid

maria: quick workaround: set env REDWOOD_OTEL_INJECT_AFTER_RETRY=true to force injection after SDK retry logic (internal-only flag). Not ideal but buys time.

alex: thanks — that flag works for my testcase. can we get a proper fix in the SDK?

maria: plan: (1) add tests for retry+otel context propagation, (2) ensure token refresh code preserves trace context across attempts, (3) add explicit header re-injection post-retry. I'll open a PR and link it here.

jong: also let's add an onboarding note about this caveat in the devex sampleapp — we should mention turning on auto-otel and retry semantics. new devs keep tripping over it.

sam: logging suggestion: if reqId missing on retry, emit a warn with delta so we can catch in prod: `WARN missing-reqid after-retry span_id=...`

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI pipeline queued for branch fix/retry-reqid — tests will run in 30m.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/489 — adds regression tests + fix. will include changelog entry about the REDWOOD_OTEL_INJECT_AFTER_RETRY interim flag.

alex: awesome — once merged can we backport to 0.24.x? customers on that patchline will need the fix.

maria: yep, will open backport PR after green CI. thanks for the clear repro — huge help. :thumbsup:
